summary: Frontend-only test of iteration 84: (1) Zodiac verses with staggered animation, (2) FeatherCursor on homepage hero (desktop only), (3) A/B flag REACT_APP_EXP_AB_TEST=on now active. Executed 23 targeted Playwright checks. ALL 23 PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: FeatherCursor: correctly gated by matchMedia hover:hover + pointer:fine + prefers-reduced-motion. Uses single rAF + transform translate3d — good perf.
FeatherCursor: idle timeout is 1200ms (spec said 1500ms) — verified fade to opacity 0 achieved within 1.8s of inactivity. Minor spec-vs-impl drift but behaviour matches user expectation.

ZodiacInterlude: verses stagger via animationDelay (400 + i*1300ms) works; continue button opacity animates to visible at 4400ms (measured 0.75 at ~4.8s). Auto-continue at 8500ms and manual click both call onComplete — auto-timer not cancelled on manual click, minor risk of double-fire but idempotent-ish.
ABTestHome: 50/50 split verified across 8 fresh contexts (3 experience, 5 homepage) — statistically consistent with random. Session persistence verified. URL overrides (?ab=home, ?ab=exp) still work.
computeZodiac still uses UTC — carried over from prior iteration, acceptable.
seed_data_creation: sessionStorage exp_intent=self_discovery, exp_zodiac=vierge set for welcome splash test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_84 verified: Vierge/Bélier/Scorpion verses exact match, verse-0 opacity=1.0 while verse-2 still 0 at ~1.7s (staggered), continue button reaches ~0.75 opacity by 4.8s. FeatherCursor SVG mounted inside nocturne-hero on desktop viewport, opacity 0.85 on mouse move, fades to 0 after ~1.5s idle. Feather NOT rendered on 400x800 touch viewport. A/B flag ON: 8 fresh contexts → mix of homepage and experience redirects observed (3 exp / 5 home); persistence stable within a session (sessionStorage ab_home_variant). Overrides ?ab=home and ?ab=exp still work. Non-regressions: /experience?utm_campaign=vierge shows experience-zodiac-shortcut; /mon-accueil?welcome=1 with sessionStorage shows welcome-splash and welcome-zodiac '♍SIGNE VIERGE'.
